_meta.datasheet_section: Figure 7 (96-ball FBGA x16, top view) + Table 4 (x16 ball descriptions) + DC operating conditions (VDD/VDDQ 1.283-1.45 V)
_meta.package: VFBGA-96 8×14 mm, 0.8 mm pitch (package code TW, Rev. P die)
_meta.notes: Same ball map for MT41K256M16TW-107:P (factory default PN, sources/MT41K256M16TW-107_PTR) and the flight IT:P (industrial). Row-A balls carry the factory's BALL_ prefix (A1..A9 collide with address-pin names; exports strip it). Table 4 prints VDD/VDDQ '1.5V ±0.075V' (DDR3 mode); the DDR3L range on p.1 is what the design uses.
